items: A **package** is a collection of related classes and interfaces grouped together into a folder.
The name of the folder is the name of the package.
The classes in the package are each placed in a separate file, and the file name begins with the name of the class.
You can use all the classes in a package within any program or class definition by placing an **`import`** statement.
The class does not need to be in the same folder as the classes in the package.

blocks.value: You met this in Lesson 1. It matters more now: as your programs grow into many classes, packages are how they stay organised.
